description: Nation-wide election impact across ALL 6 legislative levels in one call. Cascades county-level (president) overrides to senate/governor state outcomes. Computes state-chamber control where state-leg overrides exist.…

cascade_county_to_state.description: If true, county-level overrides also recompute senate + governor state outcomes via vote aggregation.

expected_version_hash.description: Required with version_id. The saved payload is computed only when its stored id and content hash match this exact identity.

version_id.description: Optional saved version to replay exactly. Requires expected_version_hash; a version from another scenario is not accepted.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: get_impact_report
